3163.  SMT. RAJANI ASHOKRAO PATIL:  
  
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
  
(a) the number of people who have signed for Covid warriors course along with the 
number of trainees who have been employed after the completion of this course at 
present, details thereof, State-wise; 
 
(b)  the number of training centres that have been set up to provide such training, State-
wise; 
 
(c) the number of people who have completed this course at present, State-wise ; and

who have completed this course, details thereof, State-wise?

MINISTER OF STATE IN THE 
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
  
(a) Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is implementing a 
special healthcare programme, ‘Customised Crash Course Programme for COVID 
Warriors (CCCP for CW) under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 3.0 (PMKVY 3.0) to 
create a pool of trained/skilled COVID warriors. Under CCCP for CW, training is being 
imparted in six customized healthcare job roles. This programme has two components viz. 
fresh skilling (short term training) followed by 3 months On-the-job training (OJT) and 
upskilling of trained candidates (for 7 days). Under the fresh skilling component of CCCP 
for CW, OJT for 3 months is considered as placement.

28.02.2022, 1,88,497 candidates have been enrolled / signed up for classroom training

training (1,49,750 - OJT linked fresh skilling and 9,908-upskilling). Out of total 1,49,750 
OJT linked fresh skilling, 1,18,386 candidates are enrolled for On-the-job training (OJT). 
The State-wise details are given at Annexure.
 
  
(b)       The State-wise number of training centres (TCs) under CCCP for CW is 
given at Annexure.

various State Governments for placement of these candidates in various 
healthcare institutions.

TO BE ANSWERED ON 30.03.2022 
  
SOCIO ECONOMIC IMPACT ASSESSMENT OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT SCHEMES 
 
3164 SHRI DEEPENDER SINGH HOODA:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether Government has conducted any socio economic impact assessment of skill 
development schemes running in the country; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c) Whether Government has roped in the private sector to increase skill development 
capacity in the country and if so, the details thereof, including the kind and number of 
companies involved under such a scheme; 
 
(d) the target fixed and achieved in last five years for training under skill development 
program, State-wise, including Haryana; and  
 
(e) the number of Ministries/Departments in the country involved in the skill development 
programmes? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR)  
 
 
(
a)&(b)     Yes Sir. All schemes presently being run by this Ministry have gone through third 
party evaluation exercise generally and also in particular, at the time of grant of extension of 
the respective schemes.   
 
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY): PMKVY 2.0 was evaluated by NITI 
Aayog in October 2020 under jobs and skills sector. The impact evaluation study draws 
inference of the scheme level contribution to the larger jobs and skills sector along with clear 
reflection of following strength and outcome achieved during implementation: 
  
408

• The training provided under the scheme is relevant to the employers and they prefer 
candidates trained under PMKVY compared to untrained candidates. 
• 52 percent of the candidates who were placed in full time/part time employment and 
had completed training under the RPL component received higher salary or felt that 
they will get higher salary compared to their peers who have no certification. 
• About 94 percent of the employers surveyed reported they would hire more 
candidates trained under the scheme. 
• About 67 percent and 18 per cent of the employers surveyed reported that the overall 
experience with respect to the recruitment process was good and very good, 
respectively. 
  
Further, third-party impact evaluation of the scheme PMKVY 2.0 (2016-20) was 
conducted by the Indian Institute of Public Administration (IIPA). The impact evaluation 
study draws following inference: 
  
• The maximum percentage of beneficiaries (70.5%) received placement in their 
desired skill sector. 
• To ensure that high standards of quality are maintained by PMKVY Training Centres, 
NSDC and empanelled inspection agencies use various yardsticks. These involve 
validations, surprise visits, and monitoring through the Skill India Portal (SIP) 
(erstwhile Skills Development Management System (SDMS)). These standards are 
intensified using the latest technologies. 
• As an impact of the scheme, 118.2% change in monthly wages of beneficiary 
trainees has been recognized. Average monthly remuneration/wages of surveyed 
beneficiaries increases from Rs. 8,422.64 to Rs. 17,871.26 post completion of 
training under PMKVY 2016-20. 
  
Jan Sikshan Sansthan (JSS): Third-party impact evaluation of the scheme JSS was 
conducted by the Indian Institute of Public Administration (IIPA) & it was completed by July, 
2020. As per the report, women representation is 79%; rural share is 50.5%; 73.4% change 
in the employment for enhanced livelihood; 89.1% change in the average income of each 
beneficiary; 85.7% mobilization of beneficiaries by JSS. 
 
Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs): The final report of Tracer Study of ITI Graduates 
(published in January 2018 by the MSDE, GoI) mentions that 63.5% of total ITI pass-outs 
got employed (wage+ self, out of which 6.7% are self-employed) and 36.4% remained 
unemployed and was looking for jobs. Even though the first figure was low for females 
(55.3%) as compared to that for males (65.1%), the corresponding figures for SCs (65%)and 
STs (69.8%) were higher than the percentage of total pass-outs in (wage+ self)employed. 
National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS): Third-party impact evaluation 
of the scheme NAPS was conducted by the National Productivity Council (NPC). As per the 
report, NAPS has been able to catalyze interest of both industry and youths towards 
apprenticeship training and coupled with strong Govt. Support and policy advocacy, the 
scheme has started to pick up the pace. There is a positive vibe across establishments and 
huge demand for apprenticeship. The two main stakeholders i.e., apprentice and the 
industry see benefits from the programme. The apprentice has found it to be useful to 
increase his/her chances of getting employment.  
 
409

(c) Yes Sir, Government involves Private-Sector Skill Development Centers/Institutes 
actively. Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras have been established under PPP mode. Jan 
Shikshan Sansthan are Non-government organizations participating in Skilling Ecosystem. 
There are 3,178 Govt. ITIs & 11,533 Private ITI’s running courses under Craftsmen Training 
Scheme. There are 19,517 Private-Sector Establishments providing apprenticeship training 
under National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme. 
 
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), under MSDE, is working with 37 
Sector Skill Councils (SSCs), which are industry-led bodies helping to ensure that short-term 
skill training meets the requirement of the industry.It is the implementation arm of MSDE, 
working in association and collaboration with different private players as Authorized 
partners, Networked entities across the country in domain of training, certification, 
employment support etc. under the overall skill value chain system.Also, Rozgar Melas are 
organized with the support of Sector Skill Councils, training providers and implementing 
agencies to directly link the candidates with the potential employers. 
 
(d) The schemes of the Ministry are demand-driven and, hence, targets are often not set  
State-wise. However, Under Skill India Mission, the Ministry of Skill Development (MSDE) 
has been delivering short term skills through Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 
(PMKVY), Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme and National Apprenticeship Promotion 
Scheme (NAPS), and long term skills through Craftsman Training Scheme (CTS) through 
Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), to the youth belonging to all section of the society across 
all over India. The details of number of youth trained under various schemes of MSDE state-
wise including Haryana are placed at Annexure I, II, III and IV. 
 
(e) More than 20 Central Ministries/Departments are involved in the Skill Development 
Programmes.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3165 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 30.03.2022 
  
PROVIDING JOBS UNDER PMKVY  
 
3165.  SHRI AYODHYA RAMI REDDY ALLA:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
  
(a) the efforts undertaken by Government under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas 
Yojana (PMKVY 3.0) to fulfill the twin objective of enabling workers to secure quality jobs 
and addressing the needs of employers and firms by providing them with the requisite 
talent for them to stay competitive; 
 
(b)  whether Government has taken into consideration the growing importance of 
remote working and increased digitalisation and automation before rolling out training 
programmes planned under PMKVY 3.0; and 
 
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE 
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR)  
 
(a) Under Skill India Mission, Ministry has launched the third phase of Pradhan Mantri 
Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 3.0) on 15.01.2021, to train 8.00 lakh youths across the 
country. Under PMKVY, training is being imparted in various National Skills Qualification 
Framework (NSQF) aligned job roles designed by industry- led Sector Skill Councils 
(SSCs).  
 
 
Ministry has designed PMKVY 3.0 as a demand driven scheme where identification 
and mapping of job roles are based on the demand received from trainees. District Skill 
Committee (DSC) supports in the identification of job roles and mobilization of candidates 
based on requirements in various sector. Further, under PMKVY 3.0, placement is being 
facilitated through the involvement of District Skill Committees and Sector Skill Councils. In 
addition, Ministry has launched Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employees Employer Mapping 
(ASEEM) portal, which acts as a central directory of skilled workforce registered and 
certified under Skill India Portal (SIP), across all schemes at central and state level
 
  
(b) and (c)      Yes, Sir. Blended Learning (Training) through digital skills is crucial in the 
post-COVID era to ensure skilling for youth and also to address the requirements of 
industry. Under PMKVY 3.0, a pilot On-line/Digital (Blended) Mode of training under STT-
PMKVY 3.0 has been launched in respect of 15 batches, and 50% of the theory hours can 
be completed via online mode.

ESTABLISHMENT OF PMKKS  
 
3166.  SHRI JOHN BRITTAS:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether all of the 812 allocated Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKKs) have 
been established throughout the country, if so, details thereof and if not, the reasons 
therefor; 
 
(b)  whether there has been delay in setting up of all PMKKs, if so, reasons therefor 
including intended timeframe for completion; 
 
(c) whether Government has undertaken a study to analyse the impact of COVID-19 
disruptions on the performance of PMKKs, if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(d) whether the PMKKs closed during previous years have been reallocated to ensure 
maximum coverage of all districts? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE 
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
  
(a) Ministry promotes establishment of model and aspirational skill centres known as 
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) in every district for imparting skill training in 
Public Private Partnership (PPP) mode throughout the country. As on date, 813 PMKKs 
have been planned and sanctioned across the country; out of which, 719 PMKKs have 
been established; 40 PMKKs are under establishment; while 54 PMKKs have been 
surrendered. The delay in setting up of remaining PMKKs was majorly due to difficult 
geographies for mobilization, and COVID-19 induced lockdown and restrictions. Presently, 
as there is some ease in restrictions, the Training Partners have been advised to 
initiate/complete the establishment process. 
  
(b)       Above reply of Part (a) may be referred. 
  
(c)        As on date, no study has been conducted for evaluating the impact of Covid-19 
disruptions on the performance of PMKKs. 
  
(d)       54 PMKKs were closed / surrendered during the last year and National Skill 
Development Corporation (NSDC) under the aegis of the Ministry is making efforts for re-
allocation of the surrendered/closed PMKKs.

HORTAGE OF SKILLED TRAINERS 
 
3167  Dr. VIKAS MAHATME:  
 
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased 
to state: 
  
(a) whether the country is facing shortage of skilled trainers to provide training to the 
candidates under various schemes of skill development; and  
 
(b) if so, what steps has Government taken to increase the number of trainers and the details 
thereof?  
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) Ministry does not maintain the data for the shor
 tage of skilled trainers. However, under 
short-term skilling eco-system, trainers are being trained through Training of Trainers (ToT) 
programme, which is being conducted by Sector Skill Councils (SSCs) and facilitated through 
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). Under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 
(PMKVY), all the trainers for short-term training have to be ToT certified. As on date, 65,450 
Trainer certifications have been completed across 37 sectors. 
 
(b) NSDC under the aegis of Ministry is implementing training program for the professional 
development of “Skill Trainers” in the short-term skill eco-system through Sector Skill Councils 
(SSCs). In order to further enhance the ToT programme, Ministry has provisioned for the direct 
funding under third phase of PMKVY to create a pool of certified trainers. 
 
 As on date,13 Trainer and Assessor academies covering 12 sectors have been set up as 
trainer development centres for conducting ToT programmes. The National Skill Development 
Corporation (NSDC) in consultation with Sector Skill Council (SSC) is facilitating the setting up of 
more such academics by private players. 
 
Also, Takshashila, a dedicated technology platform has been developed to support the 
trainer development framework such as Trainer registration, demand aggregation, batch-life 
cycle and certification.  Further, a dedicated capacity of ‘Trainer-Assessor Academies’ is being 
established which are responsible for the implementation of training of trainers program along 
with Continuous Professional Development programs 
  
In addition, Directorate General of Training, under the Ministry of Skill Development and 
Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is inter-alia implementing the Crafts Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) 
all over India through 33 National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), out of which 19 are exclusively 
for women. After completion of CITS Training, the trained individuals can be employed as Crafts 
Instructor in Industrial Training Institutes in their corresponding trades /sectors and also can join 
the industry as Technicians.

EMPLOYABILITY AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP RATE UNDER PMKVY  
 
3168.  DR. KANIMOZHI NVN SOMU:  
  
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be 
pleased to state: 
  
(a) the employability and the entrepreneurship rate of the youth trained under the 
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) at all India level during the last five years; 
 
(b)  the employability and the entrepreneurship rate of the youth trained under the 
PMKVY in Tamil Nadu; 
 
(c) the steps taken by Ministry to ensure that the persons trained under PMKVY get 
employed or start their own venture; and 
 
(d) whether Government is aware that employability rates achieved so far in the last 
five years were not upto the mark and also there were rampant corruption at this level of 
skill training? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE 
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR)  
 
(a) Under Skill India Mission, Ministry is delivering skills to the youth across the country 
through its flagship scheme Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY). It has two 
training components, namely, Short Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior 
Learning (RPL). Under PMKVY, placement opportunities are being provided to STT 
certified candidates, while RPL is not linked with placements as it recognizes the existing 
skills of candidate. Further, under PMKVY 1.0, tracking of placement was not mandatory.
 
 
Under PMKVY-STT since inception, i.e., 2015 as on 31.12.2021, 23.70 lakh 
candidates have been provided with the placement in various sectors across the country. 
Out of total placed 23.70 lakh candidates, 2.95 lakh candidates are self- employed which 
is around 12% of total placed candidates. Under PMKVY, placement of the trained 
candidates has increased from 15% in 2015-16 to 41% in 2021-22 ( till 31.12.2022) across 
the country. 
 
(b)       In the State of Tamil Nadu, under PMKVY-STT since inception, i.e., 2015 as on 
31.12.2021, 1.70 lakh candidates have been provided with the placement in various 
sectors. Out of total placed 1.70 lakh candidates, 0.24 lakh candidates are self-employed 
which is around 14% of total placed candidates. Under PMKVY, placement of the trained 
candidates has increased from 28 % in 2015-16 to 30 % in 2021-22 (till 31.12.2022) in the 
State of Tamil Nadu. 
 
418

 (c)        Under PMKVY, placement is not mandatory component. However, in order to 
enhance the placement under the short term training of PMKVY, placement is linked with 
payout to training providers. The last tranche, i.e., 30 percent of total payout is disbursed 
to training providers only on ensuring placement of the candidates.  Also, Rozgar Melas 
are organised with the support of Sector Skill Councils, training providers and 
implementing agencies to directly link the candidates with the potential employers.
 
  
            Further, based on the learning from implementation of PMKVY 1.0 (2015-16) and 
2.0 (2016-20), the orientation of the scheme has been changed from being supply driven 
to demand driven under PMKVY 3.0. Further, under PMKVY 3.0, placement is being 
facilitated through the involvement of District Skill Committees and Sector Skill Councils. In 
addition, Ministry has launched Aatmanirbhar Skilled Employees Employer Mapping 
(ASEEM) portal, which acts as a central directory of skilled workforce registered and 
certified under Skill India Portal (SIP), across all schemes at central and state level.
 
 
(d)       Under Skill India Mission, Ministry is delivering skills through Pradhan Mantri 
Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) with an objective to impart short duration skill 
development training and certification to youth to make them employable for better 
livelihood.
 
  
Under PMKVY, short term training is being imparted through skill development 
training centres (TCs) selected through accreditation and affiliation process on Skill India 
Portal (SIP). TCs are being monitored effectively through various methodologies including 
information technology (IT) interventions and measures namely; self-audit reporting, call 
validations, surprise visits and monitoring through the Skill India Portal (SIP), Aadhaar-
Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS), social media platform, etc. 
  
Further, in order to improve the monitoring under PMKVY, District Skill Committee 
(DSC) is being involved and entrusted with the monitoring under PMKVY 3.0. DSC acts as 
an on-ground monitoring agency for conducting inspection of TCs.

3172. DR. SASMIT PATRA: 
 
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the details of the steps being taken by States to preserve tribal culture and steps taken for 
their development; 
 
(b) the specific steps being taken by Odisha in this regard; and 
 
(c) how is Central Government helping Odisha in this regard? 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
 
(a):  Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) is administrating the schemes of “Support of Tribal 
Research Institute” under which grants are given  to the state Tribal Research Institutes (TRIs) 
for various projects including preservation and promotion of their art, culture, practices, 
traditions in following ways 
(i) Research studies/publication of books/documentation including audio visual documentaries 
on promotion of rich tribal cultural heritage which includes preservation of tribal languages. 
  
(ii) Tribal cultural exchange programmes. 
  
(iii) Research and documentation of Indigenous practices by tribal healers  and medicinal 
plants, Adivasi Languages, agriculture system, dances and paintings, organization of literary 
festivals, publication of books written by tribal writers/ authors, translation  works and 
literature competitions, etc. 
   
(iv) To acknowledge the heroic and patriotic deeds of tribal unsung heroes, Ministry has 
sanctioned setting up  Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum for ten states. This museum along with 
ethnographic Tribal museums will also showcase and preserve tribal artefacts related to life 
and culture of tribes. 
  
(v). Ministry  gives funding to TRIFED for organizing Adi Mahotsav festival at State 
level.  State level festivals like Hornbill festival of Nagaland, Medaram Jatra of Telangana.  
 
 (vi). The Ministry also provides grants to State Government for holistic development of tribals 
under its various schemes  like Pre and Post Matric Scholarship Schemes, SCA to TSS, Grant 
to PVTGs and MSP to MFP scheme. The Central Government also provides funds to Odisha 
under Central STC component.    
427

  
(b):   The specific steps taken by Government of Odisha with regard to preservation of  tribal 
culture are as under : 
  
(i) A Special Development Council (SDC) has been set up covering 9 most thickly concentrated 
tribal districts spread over 117 blocks and about 2000 Gram Panchayats in tribal areas 
for  protection, preservation, conservation, promotion and propagation of indigenous culture. 
Activities like – protection of Sacred Groves, Promotion of tribal dance have been undertaken. 
(ii)   An “Academy for Tribal Language and Culture” has been set up which has formulated bi-
lingual dictionaries and tri-lingual module and primers in 21 tribal languages of Odisha. 
  
(iii)  Conservation-cum-Development initiatives for the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups 
(PVTGs) have been taken up in Odisha for the 13 PVTGs. 
(iv)   To promote Multi-Lingual Education supplementary readers in all 21 tribal languages 
have been prepared and distributed among tribal children to know about their own culture.  
(v)  Also, capacity building training programmes have been provided to teachers working in 
schools for effective class room teaching. 
(vi)   Besides, Govt. of Odisha has been organizing “Dance Festival” and “ Craft Mela”. .

ATROCITIES ON TRIBALS 
3173 DR. KIRODI LAL MEENA: 
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
a) whether Government has taken note that atrocities against tribal community have 
increased in the country 
b) if so, the details thereof indicating the total number of cases reported/registered before the 
National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) regarding the oppression of tribal people in 
the country during the last three years, State-wise/UT-wise along with the action taken by NCST 
thereon; and  
c) the various corrective steps taken/being taken by Government to prevent atrocities on tribals? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SHRI BISHWESWAR TUDU) 
 
(a): As per the latest data provided by National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), details of State/ 
UT-wise Cases Registered (CR), Cases Charge-sheeted (CCS), Cases Convicted (CON), Persons 
Arrested (PAR), Person Charge-sheeted (PCS) and Persons Convicted (PCV) under Crime/ 
Atrocities against Scheduled Tribes (STs) during 2018-2020 is enclosed at Annexure-I. 
Police and Public Order are state subjects under the Seventh Schedule to the Constitution of 
India. The responsibilities to maintain law and order, protection of life and property of the citizens, and 
investigation and prosecution of crime including crime against members of Scheduled Castes and 
Scheduled Tribes rests with the respective State Governments. The State Governments are 
competent to deal with such offences under the extant provisions of law. 
 
 
(b): A statement indicating the State/ UT wise total number of cases dealt and action taken by 
National commission for Scheduled Tribes thereon regarding the oppression of Tribal people during 
last three years is given at Annexure-II. 
 
(c): An Act of the Parliament namely the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention 
of Atrocities) {PoA} Act, 1989 was enacted to prevent atrocities against members of Scheduled 
Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) which has been amended in 2015 to make it more effective. 
The amended act includes new offences, expanded scope of presumptions, institutional 
strengthening, which inter-alia includes establishment of Exclusive Special Courts and specification 
of Exclusive Special Public Prosecutors to exclusively try the offences under the PoA Act to enable 
expeditious disposal of cases, power of Special Courts and Exclusive Special Courts to take direct 
cognizance of offences and as far as possible, completion of trial within two months from the date of 
filing of the charge sheet, establishing rights of victims and witnesses, and strengthening preventive 
measures. This Act also provides relief / compensation to the victims and also prescribes action to 
be taken by the law implementing agencies in conjunction with IPC in the country. Police and Public  
 
 
429

 
 
Order are State Subjects under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India.The State 
Governments/ Union Territory Administration are primarily responsible for prevention, detection, 
registration, investigation and prosecution of crimes within their jurisdiction including crimes against 
members of Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs), as also for implementation of the 
Protection of Civil Rights (PCR) Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes 
(Prevention of Atrocities) {PoA} Act, 1989 . The Government has been reviewing with the law 
implementing agencies of the State Government for ensuring prompt registration of atrocities, speedy 
investigation of the offences and timely dispensing of cases by the Courts. Further, Government of 
India has issued advisories to the State Governments/UT Administration from time to time for effective 
implementation of the PoA Act and Rules in letter and spirit.

TO BE ANSWERED ON- 30/03/2022 
  
FUNDS PROVIDED AND SPENT UNDER ARTICLE 275A 
  
3175 # SHRI AJAY PRATAP SINGH: 
  
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
  
a) whether the funds provided to the States under Article 275A have been spent for some 
other purpose by any State; 
b) if so, the persons accountable for this and the details of the action taken against them;  
c) by when the utilization certificate under this Article will be submitted by the remaining States;  
d) whether any time limit has been set for this purpose; and 
e) if so, by when and if not, the reasons therefor? 
  
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
  
(a) and (b):  Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) provides funds to States under Article 275(1) (not under 
275A)  of the Constitution based on the proposal received from them after obtaining approval of Project 
Appraisal Committee in the Ministry. It is the responsibility of the States to utilize the funds for the purpose 
for which it is sanctioned.  No such instances have come to the notice of the Ministry where any State has 
utilized the sanctioned funds under Grant under Article 275(1) of the Consitituion for any other purpose 
than it was sanctioned for.  
  
However, in case of Madhya Pradesh, attention of this Ministry has been drawn towards change in nature 
of one of the component of project namely ‘Organic Agriculture support program through Vermicompost 
Unit -Fertilizer/ Organic Manure’ sanctioned  during 2016-17 under the then Scheme ‘Special Central 
Assistance to Tribal Sub-Scheme (SCA to TSS)’ and the scheme ‘Development of Particularly Vulnerable 
Tribal Groups (PVTGs)’.   The matter has been taken up with the State Government to resolve the issue 
and take appropriate action.  
  
(c) to (e):  As per provision of GFRs, Utilization Certificate (UC) in respect of non-recurring Grants 
becomes due after twelve months of the closure of the financial year and in case of recurring Grants it 
becomes due immediately after closure of the financial year.  Accordingly all States are periodically being 
requested by this Ministry to submit outstanding UC as per timelines stipulated under the provisions of 
GFRs.  Most of the States have adhered to timelines in this regard and in case of non-submission of UC by 
some of the States due to non-completion of approved project, the outstanding amount is adjusted by the 
Ministry with the subsequent release of funds to the concerned State under the scheme.

TO BE ANSWERED ON- 30/03/2022 
  
VOCATIONAL TRAINING IN TRIBAL AREAS 
  
3179.  SHRI K.R.N. RAJESHKUMAR: 
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
a) the details of the schemes and the steps taken by Government to provide vocational training in tribal 
areas; 
b) the details of the vocational training centres currently working in tribal areas of the country; 
c) whether these schemes are commensurate with the tribal population; 
d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise/UT- wise; and 
e) if not, the steps and the measures taken by Government in this regard? 
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR TRIBAL AFFAIRS 
(SMT. RENUKA SINGH SARUTA) 
  
(a) to (e):  Ministry of Tribal Affairs was  implementing a separate Scheme till 2018, under which funds were 
provided for running Vocational Training Centres (VTCs) by the State Governments / NGOs. The Vocational 
Training Centres that were run by various State Governments are at Annexure 1. 
However, with the creation of Ministry of skill Development  as a separate Ministry in 2014 and 
compulsory requirement of National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF), from 2018-19 onwards, the 
intervention of Vocational Training Centres was subsumed under the Schemes of ‘Special Central Assistance 
to Tribal Sub-Scheme (SCA to TSS) and Grants under Article 275(1) of the Constitution.  Now for carrying 
out Skill Development / Vocational Training programmes, funds are provided to State Governments based 
on  proposals received from them which are appraised and approved by the Project Appraisal Committee 
(PAC) with in the state's allocation. Details of funds provided for skill development and vocational training of 
tribal persons under the schemes ‘Special Central Assistance to Tribal Sub-Scheme (SCA to TSS) and Grants 
under Article 275(1) of the Constitution during last four years is at Annexure 2. 
               Besides, under Van Dhan Vikas Karyakram,which is targeted at livelihood generation for tribals, 
traditional knowledge and skill sets of tribals are enhanced by adding technology & IT to help them becoming 
self-reliant and entrepreneurs. Under this Karyakram, tribal community owned Minor Forest Produce (MFP) 
centric multi-purpose Van Dhan Vikas Kendra (VDVKs) are set-up in tribal dominated districts. The members 
are given skill training and provided tool kits for processing of MFP and development of value chain. Details 
of State-wise No. of VDVKs sanctioned  with beneficiaries are at Annexure 3.

“IMPROVING NUTRITIONAL LEVELS OF THE POPULATION” 
                                                                                     
  
3186   SHRI S. SELVAGANABATHY: 
  
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)    whether Government agrees with the view that improving the overall nutritional 
levels of the population requires more substantial Government intervention on 
the food front; 
(b)    if so, what initiatives have been taken/is being taken by Government keeping in 
view the fact that nutrition levels are majorly affected by the education level of 
women and income of households; and 
(c)    if not, the reasons therefor?  
  
  
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
  
(a)       Malnutrition is a multi- faceted problem. The important determinants are 
inadequate food, level of poverty leading to low purchasing power, poor socio- 
economic status of women, female illiteracy, high rate of population growth and low 
access of population to health education, safe drinking water, environmental, sanitation, 
hygiene and other social services. Key reasons for malnutrition setting in early life are 
early marriage, faulty and sub-optimal infant and young child feeding practices, 
childhood illnesses and low birth weight. The nutritional status of the population is 
outcome of complex and inter-related set of factors and requires convergent efforts.  
 
(b) to (c) The Government has accorded high priority to the issue of malnutrition and is 
implementing several schemes/programmes of different Ministries/Departments through 
States/UTs to address various aspects related to nutrition. Government is implementing 
POSHAN Abhiyaan, Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, Anganwadi Services and 
Scheme for Adolescent Girls under the Umbrella Integrated Child Development 
Services Scheme (ICDS) as direct targeted interventions to address the problem of 
malnutrition in the country.  
    
     
 
461

 
 
POSHAN Abhiyaan launched on 8th March 2018, aims to reduce malnutrition in 
the country by adopting a synergised and result oriented approach.Mission Poshan 2.0, 
an integrated nutrition support programme has been announced in budget 2021-2022 
for all States/UTs. It seeks to strengthen nutritional content, delivery, outreach and 
outcomes with focus on developing practices that nurture health, wellness and 
immunity to disease and malnutrition. 
 
Under the Wheat Based Nutrition Programme (WBNP), food grains 
(wheat/rice/Millets) are allocated at subsidized rates under NFSA to the States/UTs for 
preparation of supplementary food under Anganwadi Services. As envisaged in the 
Hon’ble Prime Minister’s Address on 75th Independence Day, Fortified Rice have to be 
provided through every Government Scheme by the year 2024, therefore, From the 2nd 
quarter of FY 2021-22 under WBNP, Fortified Rice in lieu of Standard Rice has been 
allocated to all the State/UTs which helps in fighting malnutrition and anemia in women 
and children arising due to deficiency of micronutrients like Iron, Folic Acid and Vitamin 
B-12. 
 
POSHAN Scheme is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented in partnership with the 
States and UTs. The overall responsibilities for providing cooked and nutritious mid-day 
meal to the eligible children lies with the State Governments and Union Territory 
Administrations in accordance with the Guidelines laid down by the Central 
Government.  Children in the age group of 6 months to 3 years, age group 3 to 6 years 
and pregnant women and lactating mothers are provided Take Home Ration or  Hot 
Cooked Meals under Anganwadi Services Scheme. States and UTs determine their 
recipes according to local needs and as per nutritional norms specified under Schedule 
II of the National Food Security Act, 2013.

(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
(a) to (c) Under the National Health Mission, ASHAs are envisaged to be community health 
volunteers and are entitled to task/activity based incentives. Hence ASHAs are not paid 
remuneration, but only receive a fixed monthly incentive of Rs. 2000 per month for undertaking 
routine and recurring activities and the details are placed at Annexure-I. Additionally, she is also 
provided performance-based incentives for a varied set of activities under various National Health 
Programmes which are placed at Annexure- II.  
  
Under National Health Mission, States/UTs in their programme implementation plans have 
been given flexibility to provide a range of monetary incentives to the ASHAs and the same are 
placed at Annexure-III. 
  
      After the launch of the Ayushman Bharat scheme with operationalisation of Ayushman 
Bharat- Health and Wellness Centres (AB-HWCs), ASHAs are now additionally eligible for Team 
Based Incentives (TBIs) along with ANMs based on monitored performance indicators (up to Rs. 
1000 per month).  
  
The government has also approved a cash award of Rs. 20,000/- and a citation to ASHAs 
who leave the programme after working as ASHAs for minimum of 10 years, as 
acknowledgement of their contribution.  
  
Also, in view of the significant contribution towards the COV ID-19 pandemic related work 
by ASHAs, States were advised to pay an additional incentive of Rs.1000/- per month for those 
ASHAs engaged in COVID-19 related work using the resources of COVID-19 Health System 
Preparedness and Emergency Response Package.  
  
In the year 2018, the ASHA benefit package was introduced acknowledging significant 
contribution and commitment of ASHAs. The package providing coverage for:

“DEATHS OF CHILDREN DUE TO MALNUTRITION” 
  
  
3189   SHRI NEERAJ DANGI: 
  
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)    the number of deaths due to malnutrition recorded during the last three years; 
(b)    whether it is a fact that malnutrition causes many deaths of children in the 
country; 
(c)    if so, the reasons therefor; 
(d)    the details of financial assistance provided by Government to the States for 
tackling malnutrition; and 
(e)    whether Government has taken any other remedial measures? 
  
  
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) to (c) Malnutrition is not a direct cause of death. No deaths due to malnutrition have 
been recorded by any State / UT and no such information has been provided by any 
State / UT. However, malnutrition may increase morbidity by reducing resistance to 
infections. Under Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child, Adolescent Health 
(RMNCAH) strategy of National Health Mission (NHM), various activities are conducted 
across the country and these activities contribute in child survival as well as 
improvement in the nutritional status of children. 
  
  
(d) Details of financial assistance provided by Government to the States/UTs during 
their Annual Programme Implementation Plan (APIP) for implementation of RMNCAH 
strategy is placed at Annexure I. Under POSHAN Abhiyaan, the details of funds 
allocated to States/UTs in order to address malnutrition is at Annexure II.  
  
(e) (i) The Government has accorded high priority to the issue of malnutrition and is 
implementing several schemes like Anganwadi Services, Scheme for Adolescent Girls 
and Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) under the Umbrella Integrated 
Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme as direct targeted interventions to 
address the problem of malnutrition in the country. 
471

Further, POSHAN Abhiyaan launched on 8th March 2018, aims to reduce 
malnutrition in the country in a phased manner, through a lifecycle approach, by 
adopting a synergised and result oriented approach. 
 
Mission Poshan 2.0, an integrated nutrition support programme has been 
announced in budget 2021-2022 for all States/UTs. It seeks to strengthen nutritional 
content, delivery, outreach and outcomes with focus on developing practices that 
nurture health, wellness and immunity to disease and malnutrition. Guidelines were 
issued for transparency and accountability in delivery of supplementary nutrition and to 
track nutritional outcomes on 13.01.2021. 
 
(ii)   Under NHM, there are 1080 Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs) operational 
across the country. These NRCs provide medical and nutritional care of the admitted 
sick children with Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM).

SCHEME FOR ADOLESCENT GIRLS 
  
3190. DR. AMAR PATNAIK: 
                                                                         
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether a study has been conducted to analyse the implementation of the Scheme for 
Adolescent Girls (SAG); 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; 
(c)  whether the assembly of all adolescent girls in Anganwadi centers has motivated the 
out-of-school girls to join school; 
(d)  if so, the details thereof; 
(e)  whether under the SAG, only 5.03 lakh girls were beneficiaries in 2021, much lower 
than 11.88 lakh beneficiaries in 2018-2019; 
(f)  if so, the reasons therefor; 
(g)  whether the Ministry has taken any other measures to ensure that out- of-school 
adolescent girls are brought back to educational institutes; and 
(h)  if so, the details thereof?  
  
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) & (b) Yes, Sir. An evaluation of Schemes of the Ministry of Women & Child Development 
including Scheme for Adolescent Girls was conducted by NITI Ayog during 2020.  
  
(c) to (f)  Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG), a Centrally-sponsored scheme,  aimed at 
providing nutritional support to out of school girls in the age group of 11-14 years for improving 
their health and nutritional status and motivated them to go back to formal schooling, provided 
life skill training, accessing public services etc. However, Right to Education Act, 2009 
provides legal entitlement for compulsory and free education to AGs in the age group of 11-14 
years and all the AGs in this group are entitled to go-to school wherein they are provided mid 
day meal for improving their nutritional status. Hence, a decline in the number of beneficiaries 
was seen under the Scheme due to the RTE Act.  
  
Since the adolescent girls in the age group of 11-14 years are being covered under the RTE 
Act, recently the Scheme for Adolescent Girls has been revised and subsumed under 
Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 wherein the targeted beneficiaries are all the AGs in the 
age group of (14+) to18 years in the Aspirational Districts and the North Eastern States. 
  
(g) & (h) The Government of India has launched a campaign “Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav” 
on 07.03.2022 under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Scheme to ensure that all the out- of-school 
Adolescent Girls in the age group of 11-14 years are enrolled back to formal schooling.

OBJECTIVE AND SALIENT FEATURES OF MAHILA POLICE VOLUNTEERS 
  
3191.  SHRI K.C. VENUGOPAL: 
  
  Will the Minister of Women and Child Development be pleased to state:  
 
(a) the objective and salient features of Mahila Police Volunteers (MPVs) sc he 
me being implemented by Government; 
(b) the number of States in which the scheme is in operation at present and the st
eps taken by Government to implement the Scheme in all States; 
(c) the details of powers assigned to MPVs to check crimes against women along 
withregistration process and success rate after inclusion of such volunteers sin
ce implementation of scheme; and 
(d) the measures taken by Government to create awareness and sensitisation am
ong young women and adolescents about MPVs in the country? 
 
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) to (d) : The Scheme of Mahila Police Volunteers (MPV) envisaged these 
Volunteers as empowered, responsible and socially aware women for fostering 
leadership in local settings to facilitate police outreach on gender concerns. The broad 
mandate of MPVs is to report incidences of violence against women such as domestic 
violence, child marriage, dowry harassment and violence faced by women in public 
spaces. Under the scheme, approvals were given to the proposals received from 13 
States/ UTs. However, this scheme could be made functionalal only in 7 States / UTs 
with reported number of over 9,900 MPVs. 
  
A third party Evaluation Study of Mahila Police Volunteers (MPV) Scheme was 
conducted by NITI Aayog. The said study found inadequacies in institutional structure 
and implementation of the scheme. Taking into account the findings of the third party 
evaluation, the past experiences and in consultation with States/ Stakeholders, it has 
been decided to discontinue the Mahila Police Volunteers Scheme during the 15th 
Finance Commission Cycle, while suitably incorporating appropriate provisions under 
other components of ''Mission Shakti'', an umbrella scheme for safety and 
empowerment of women.

BENEFIT UNDER PMMVY 
  
3192.     SHRI K. C. VENUGOPAL; 
             
Will the Minister of Women and Child Development be pleased to state: 
                            
(a)      whether benefits under Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is 
conditional and restricted to one child per women; 
(b)      if so, the details thereof and the reasons for restricting the benefit under the 
scheme only for the first birth; 
(c)   the details of the critical issues that have been reported regarding the 
functioning/implementation of the yojana along with the corrective 
measures taken/being taken by the government  
(d)      whether government proposes to provide cash incentive for medical care 
and nutrition support to the women beneficiaries under the scheme and if 
so, the details thereof? 
  
  
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER FOR WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
   
(a) & (b)     Currently, the maternity benefit under the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana 
Yojana (PMMVY) is available to the eligible beneficiaries for first living child. 
Normally, the first pregnancy of a woman exposes her to new kinds of challenges 
and stress factors. Hence, the scheme provides support to the mother for safe 
delivery and immunization of her first living child.  
  
PMMVY covers all Pregnant Woman & Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), 
excluding PW&LM who are in regular employment with the Central Government or 
the State Governments or the Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) or those who are 
in receipt of similar benefits under any law for the time being in force. 
  
Mission Shakti Scheme has been launched recently to provide integrated 
benefits of safety, security and empowerment to women. PMMVY has been 
revamped and included as a sub-scheme under Mission Shakti. In  the revamped 
PMMVY maternity benefit amounting to Rs. 6000/- is also to be provided for the 
second child, but only if, the second child a girl child, to discourage pre-birth sex 
selection and to promote and celebrate the girl child.  
  
477

(c)        The operational difficulties faced by the States/UTs in implementation of the 
scheme, as and when reported, are addressed through mutual/ technical 
discussions. To further reduce the compliance burden on the beneficiary, the number 
of installments under the scheme have also been reduced from 3 to 2 in the 
revamped scheme. 
  
(d)       PMMVY envisages payment of maternity benefits of ₹5,000/ - in beneficiary’s 
bank/ post office account linked to her Aadhaar Number in Direct Benefit Transfer 
(DBT) mode. The eligible beneficiary is entitled to receive the remaining cash 
incentive as per approved norms towards Maternity Benefit under Janani Suraksha 
Yojana (JSY) after institutional delivery so that on an average, a woman gets ₹6000/- 
 
The objective of the scheme is to provide partial compensation for the wage loss in 
terms of cash incentive so that the woman can take adequate rest before and after 
delivery of the first child and the cash incentive provided would lead to improved 
health seeking behavior amongst the Pregnant Women & Lactating Mothers 
(PW&LM).

SHELTER HOMES FOR WIDOWS 
  
3196  SMT. AMBIKA SONI 
 
Will the Minister of WOMEN CHILD AND DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:  
 
(a) 
 whether Government had set up a shelter home for widows at Vrindavan in Uttar 
Pradesh (UP) under Swadhar Greh Scheme, if so, the details thereof along with 
capacity of residents vis-a vis present occupancy in the shelter home; 
(b)  the number of shelter homes constructed by Government for homeless women 
across the country, State-wise; 
(c)  the reasons for very low occupancy in the shelter homes; and  
(d)  the fresh steps taken by the Government to encourage more homeless widows 
to come and stay in such shelter homes? 
  
ANSWER  
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) The Ministry of Women and Child Development is implementing the Swadhar Greh 
Scheme revised with effect from 1 st April 2016. The Scheme caters to primary needs of 
women in difficult circumstances – women and girls rendered homeless due to family 
discord, crime, violence, mental stress, social ostracism or are being forced into 
prostitution and are in moral danger. Through the provisions of shelter, food, clothing, 
counseling, training, clinical and legal aid, the Scheme aims to rehabilitate such women 
in difficult circumstance economically and emotionally. 
 
The Ministry has constructed Home for Widows, namely, 'Krishna Kutir' at Vrindavan, 
Mathura in Uttar Pradesh which can accommodate 1000 widows. The home is fully 
funded by the Ministry. It aims to provide the widows a safe and secure place of stay, 
health services, nutritious food, legal and counselling services. This Home was 
inaugurated on 31.08.2018 and it is the largest shelter home for widows in the country. 
The capacity of residents in ‘Krishna Kutir’ is 1000 and present occupancy is 140. 
 
(b) Most of the Swadhar Grehs are running in the rented buildings. One Swadhar Greh 
in Madhya Pradesh and three, including one Krishna Kutir, have been constructed in 
Uttar Pradesh.  
  
(c) and (d) Swadhar Grehs do not have low occupancy, which stands at 76.2% at all 
India level during 2021-22. Under the new Mission Shakti, it is envisaged to revise the 
Scheme guidelines to make them more useful for the beneficiaries and spread 
awareness about these homes through the National Hub for Empowerment of Women.

(a)  whether Government has paid any risk allowance and any safety gear to the 
ASHA, Anganwadi and Mid-Day Meal Workers who risked their lives extending 
COVID-19 duties, if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; 
(b)  the year-wise details on allocation for ICDS during the last five years; and

ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
 
(a) Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package (PMGKP) Insurance Scheme for Health 
Care Workers Fighting COVID-19 was launched to provide comprehensive personal 
accident cover of Rs.50 Lakh to 22.12 lakh health care providers and the same has 
been extended to ASHA as well as Anganwadi Workers, who may have been in direct 
contact and care of COVID-19 patients and may be at risk of being impacted by this 
subject to fulfillment of the certain conditions.  States/UTs have been asked to ensure 
provision of safety tools like masks, gloves, soaps and sanitizers etc. for ASHAs as 
well as Anganwadi Workers.  
 
Under the National Health Mission, ASHAs are envisaged to be community 
health volunteers and are entitled to task/activity based incentives. However, in view of 
the significant contribution towards the COVID-19 pandemic related work by ASHAs, 
States were advised to pay an additional incentive of Rs.1000/- per month for those 
ASHAs engaged in COVID-19 related work using the resources of COVID-19 Health 
System Preparedness and Emergency Response Package. Provisions are also made 
for continued full payment of the existing Routine and Recurring Incentive of Rs. 2000 
per month to ASHAs to ensure delivery of essential health services during the 
pandemic along with additional COVID-19 incentives for ASHAs.

Under PM Poshan (earlier known as Mid- Day Meal Scheme), Cook-cum-
helpers (CCHs) are engaged for preparing and serving hot cooked meals at schools. 
They are honorary workers who come forward for rendering social services. In

for 10 months in a year. Honorarium is also provided to CCHs for preparing and 
serving hot cooked meals in elementary schools during summer vacation in drought 
affected areas notified by the concerned State Governments. The honorarium 
expenditure is shared between the Central Government and States/ UTs as per 
approved sharing pattern. Some State Governments and UT Administrations also 
supplement the honorarium by providing additional funds from their own resources.

OBJECTIVE AND SALIENT FEATURES OF MAHILA SHAKTI KENDRA SCHEME 
  
3198  SHRI SANJAY SETH:  
  
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
  
(a)   the objective and salient feature of Mahila Shakti Kendra scheme being 
implemented by Government along with the challenges faced while implementing 
the scheme in the country;  
(b)    the number of rural women who have been empowered through community 
participation under the scheme;  
(c)   the States that are contributing their respective share of funds along with the 
steps taken by Government to provide more funds under this scheme; and  
(d)   whether the State Governments including Uttar Pradesh have sent proposals for 
setting up of more centres under the scheme in various districts, if so, the details 
thereof? 
 
  
 ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) & (b) : The Mahila Shakti Kendra (MSK) Scheme was approved in November, 2017 
as a centrally sponsored scheme to empower rural women through community 
participation. The scheme aims to facilitate inter-sectoral convergence of schemes and 
programs meant for women. A third party evaluation about the functioning of MSK 
scheme has been done by the Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO), 
NITI Aayog and based on the recommendations,  it has been decided that the MSK 
Scheme may be subsumed under the other component of Mission Shakti, an umbrella 
scheme for safety and empowerment of women. The data of beneficiaries under the 
Scheme is not maintained centrally.  
  
(c) :  The scheme is implemented through State Governments and UT Administrations 
with a cost sharing ratio of 60:40 between Centre and States except for North East & 
Special Category States where the funding ratio is 90:10. For Union Territories, 100% 
central funding is provided.  
  
(d) :     As on date, out of 640 District Level Centres for Women (DLCWs) approved 
under the MSK Scheme, 314 DLCWs are functional across the country including 71 
DLCWs in the State of Uttar Pradesh.

GENDER BUDGETING SYSTEM 
  
 3199   SHRI K.R.N. RAJESHKUMAR: 
   
 Will the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state: 
  
(a)  whether Government has adopted Gender Budgeting System (GBS) in order to 
strategize gender mainstreaming across sectors and at all levels of governance 
in the country, if so, the details thereof indicating the current status and 
progress made in this regard; 
(b)  the funds allocated/released to Central/State Government/Autonomous 
Institutions for mainstreaming gender concern during the last three years; and 
(c)  whether the gender responsive budgeting statement has any impact on actual 
allocation of funds during the project design phase and if so, the details thereof 
and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF WOMEN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT 
(SHRIMATI SMRITI ZUBIN IRANI) 
  
(a) The Government is committed for promoting gender equality in all sectors and at 
all levels of governance. Financing for gender equality is central to mitigate gender 
inequalities and Gender Budgeting is a critical strategy in this endeavour. The 
Government has adopted Gender Budgeting as a strategy to incorporate a gender 
perspective in all stages of policy making. 
  
The Government has emphasised that Gender Budgeting includes gender sensitive 
formulation of legislation, policies, plans, programs, schemes, resource allocation, 
implementation, monitoring, audit and impact assessment of programs and schemes. 
In this regard, the Ministry has focused on (i) establishing institutional mechanisms 
and processes to undertake Gender Budgeting in all Ministries/Departments at the 
national and State/UT level and (ii) strengthening capacities and building expertise 
across levels of governance on undertaking Gender Budgeting. 
  
(b) The Ministry of Women and Child Development is implementing a scheme on 
Gender Budgeting to provide financial grant- in-aid to government departments, 
national and state training institutes and organisations to conduct training and 
workshops to build capacities of various stakeholders on Gender Budgeting. The 
funds allocated/released during the last three years are as under:

(c)      if so, the number of complaints lodged and resolved in such centres during the   
last three years?

(a) to (c): The Government implements the One Stop Centre (OSC) Scheme, 
popularly known as Sakhi One Stop Centres, across the country with effect from 1st 
April 2015 under Nirbhaya Fund with the objective to provide integrated support and 
assistance under one roof with a range of services including police facilitation, medical

management of OSCs. As of now, 733 OSCs have been approved for setting up in 36

over 4.93 lakh women across the country. In the State of Uttarakhand, 13 OSCs are

(मनरेगा) के  तहत पूरे देश में 4 लाख आंगनवाडी भवनों के  हनमाचण के  हलए महहला एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्रालय, 
ग्रामीण हवकास  मंत्रालय और पंर्ायती राज मंत्रालय द्वारा संशोहधत संयुक्त कदशा-हनदेश जारी ककए  गए; 
ii. स्वच्छता कायच  योजना के  तहत पेयजल की  सुहवधाओं के  हलए 10,000 रुपये प्रहत आंगनवाडी क ें द्र और शौर्ालय की  
सुहवधाओं के  हलए 12,000 रुपये प्रहत आंगनवाडी क ें द्र प्रदान ककए  जाते हैं;  
iii. वाटर कि्टर, िनीर्र, उपकरण  आकद खरीदने के  हलए अनुदान स्वीक ृ त ककए  जाते हैं;  
iv. क ु शलता के  साथ सेवाएं प्रदान करने  के  हलए आंगनवाडी कायचकर्भत्रयों (एडब्ल्यूडब्ल्यू) को  स्माटच िोन कदए गए हैं; 
v. गुणवत्ता आश्वासन, ड्यूटीधारकों की  भूहमकाएं  और हजम्मेदाररयां, खरीद की  प्रकिया, आयुष की  संक्पनाओं  का  
एकीकरण  और पूरक  पोषण के  हवतरण में पारदर्भशता, क ु शलता और जवाबदेही लाने के  हलए पोषण ट्रैकर के  माध्यम से 
आंकडा  प्रबंधन और हनगरानी जैसे अनेक  पहलुओं को  शाहमल करते  हुए 13.01.2021 को  सुव्यवहस्थत कदशा-हनदेश 
जारी ककए  गए।  
 
हाल ही में सक्षम आंगनवाडी और पोषण 2.0 के  तहत आंगनवाडी सेवा स्कीम का  हवलय हो गया है। सक्षम आंगनवाडी और 
पोषण 2.0 के  तहत पोषण सामग्री के  हवतरण में सुधार के  हलए प्रहत वषच 40,000 आंगनवाडी क ें द्र की  दर से 2 लाख 
आंगनवाडी क ें द्रों को  सुदृढ़, अपग्रेड और पुनरुद्धार ककया  जाएगा हजसमें हशक्षा हवकास  कायचिमों के  अहभसरण में 6 साल से कम  
आयु के  बच्चों के  रर्नात्मक, सामाहजक , भावनात्मक, संज्ञानात्मक और बौहद्धक हवकास  उत्प्रेरण के  हलए पोषण वारटकाओं  का  
हवकास , इंटरनेट/वाई-िाई कनेहक्टहवटी सहहत बेहतर  अवसंरर्ना के  साथ और सेवाएं प्रदान करना /जोडना, एलईडी स्िीन, वाटर 
प्युरीिायर/आरओ मशीन लगाना और स्माटच अध्ययन सहायक  सामग्री, श्रव्य-दृश्य सामग्री तथा बच्चों के  अनुक ू ल सीखने के  उपकरण  
सहहत प्रारंहभक बा्यावस्था देखरेख और हशक्षा शाहमल है।

प्रोफ े सर की शनयुवि हेतु पीएचडी आिश्यकता को  1.07.2023 से लागू करते ह ुए विशनयमन में 
संिोधन ककया गया है।  
(ख) वििेषज्ञ सशमशत की शसफाररिों क े  आधार पर, यूसीजी ने ऑनलाइन और मुि द ूरथथ शिक्षा 
कायहक्रम विशनयमों में संिोधन का प्रथताि ककया  है। प्रथतावित संिोधनों क े  अनुसार, उच्च शिक्षा 
संथथान (एचईआई) प्रौद्योशगकी रखरखाि, अशधगम प् लेटफॉमह, विज्ञापन और विपिन इत् याकद के  
संबंध में िैक्षक्षक प्रौद्योशगकी फमों की सेिाओं का लाभ उठा सकते हैं। हालांकक , प्रौद्योशगकी फमह क े  
िैक्षक्षक सहयोग क े साथ अथिा इसक े वबना ऑनलाइन कायहक्रम प्रदान करने की पूरी क्षजम्मेदारी 
एचईआई की होगी । ऐसे कायहक्रमों क े  संबंध में ककसी भी प्रकार का विज्ञापन या विपिन

क्या शिक्षा मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककाः  
(क) क्या सरकार को इस बात की जानकारी है कक प्राथशमक विद्यालयों , माध्यशमक विद्यालयों, 
महाविद्यालयों और विश्वविद्यालयों में बडी संखया में शिक्षकों क े  पद ररक्त पडे हुए हैं जजसक े  कारण 
शिक्षण पर प्रशतकूल प्रभाि पड रहा है; और  
(ख) यकद हां , तो आिश्यकता अनुसार शिक्षकों की भती करने क े  शलए क्या कदम उठाए जा रहे हैं ? 
 
उत्तर 
शिक्षा मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्रीमती अन्नपूणाा देिी) 
 
(क ) से (ख ) शिक्षा संविधान की समिती सूची में है। विशभन्न शिक्षण संस्थानों में शिक्षकों की भती 
एक सतत प्रकिया है और  ररवक्तयां सेिाशनिृवत्त, इस्तीफ े  और छात्रों की बढी हुई संखया/नए स्कूलों/नए 
संस्थानों की अशतररक्त आिश्यकताओं क े  कारण उत्पन्न होती रहती हैं। स्कूल शिक्षकों की भती, सेिा 
ितें और तैनाती संबंशधत राज्य और संघ राज् य क्षेत्र (यूटी) सरकार क े  अशधकार क्षेत्र में हैं। ररक्त 
शिक्षण पदों को भरने का दाशयत्ि उन विश्वविद्यालयों का है जो क ें द्रीय अशधशनयम, राज्य अशधशनयम या 
प्रांतीय अशधशनयम क े  तहत स्थावपत स्िायत्त शनकाय हैं और स्कूलों क े  मामले में यह दाशयत्ि संबंशधत 
राज्य सरकारों का है। तथावप, शिक्षा मंत्रालय राज्यों, संघ राज् य क्षेत्रों की सरकारों , स्िायत्त शनकायों आकद 
से समीक्षा बैठक ें  आयोजजत करक े  ि समय-समय पर एडिाइजरी  जारी करक े  ररवक्तयों को भरने का 
अनुरोध करता है।

(क ) से (ग): भारतीय प्रौद्योशगकी संस्थान (आईआईटी)  राष्ट्रीय महत्ि क े संस्थानों क े रूप में 
स्थावपत है और प्रौद्योशगकी संस्थान अशधशनयम, 1961 और उसक े  तहत बनाई गई संविशधयों द्वारा 
िाशसत हैं ।  सरकार ने क्षेत्रीय आकांक्षाओं और विज्ञान, इंजीशनयररंग और प्रौद्योशगकी में 
गुणित्तापूणा शिक्षा की मांग पूरी करने क े  शलए िषा 1963 तक स्थावपत पांच (5) आईआईटी 
की संखया को धीरे -धीरे बढाकर 23 कर कदया है।  इसने ग्रामीण पृष्ठभूशम क े  छात्रों सकहत देि 
भर क े  छात्रों क े  शलए इन प्रमुख संस्थानों से उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त करने क े  अिसरों में िृवि की 
है। जेईई ( एडिांस्ड) प्रिेि परीक्षा क े  माध्यम से, आईआईटी में अिर स्नातक (यूजी)

कायाक्रमों में प्रिेि कदए जाने क े  अलािा , देि भर क े  विशभ न् न क े न् रों पर प्रिेि परीक्षा

सामग्री को कोई भी , कहीं भी , कभी भी शनाःिुल्क एक्सेस कर सकता है।  भारतीय प्रौद्योशगकी 
संस्थान-प्रोफ े सर अशसस्टेड लशनिंग (आईआईटी-पीएएल) सरकार की एक और पहल है जो

क े  शलए आईआईटी प्रोफ े सरों और वििेषज्ञ शिक्षकों द्वारा जीि विज्ञान, रसायन विज्ञान, गजणत

भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (एनएचएआई) के माध्यम से तनष्ट्पादित ककए जा रहे राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ों के रख रखाव और ववकास के शलए राज्यवार तनधि आवंदित नहीं करता है। 2019 से अब तक , 
राज्य लोक तन मागण ववभार्, तशमलनाडु सरकार  के माध्यम से तनष्ट्पादित ककए जा रहे राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ों के 
तनमागण और रखरखाव के शलए 2651 करोड़ रुपये का  आवंिन ककया  र्या है।

राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ों के तनमागण और रखरखाव के शलए 2019 से अब तक 7592 करोड़ रुपये खचग ककए र्ए

और

पर पूरी हो च ु
की हैं तथा आज की तारीख तक लंबबत पररयोजनाओं और उक्त लंबबत पररयोजनाओं  के कब तक पूरा 
होने की सं भावना है, का वववरण   संलग्न हैं।  
(र्) सरकार ने पररयोजनाओं को प ूरा कक या जाना  सुननजचचत करने  के  ललए भूलम अर्धग्रहण और पयागवरण मंजू

राज्य सरकार और ववलभन्न  थतरों पर ठेकेिारों आदि के साथ लर्ातार समीक्षा बैठकों जैसे  ववलभन्न किम उठाए हैं।

पररयोजनाओं में , समय की अर्धकता के कारण लार्त में कोई व ृद्र्ध नहीं होती है क्योंकक वृद्र्ध लार्त ररयायतग्राही 
द्वारा वहन की जाती है। अन्य पररयोजनाओं में , यदि िेरी ठेकेिार के कारण होती है , तो हजागना लर्ाया जाता है और 
मूल्य वृद्र्ध का भु
र्तान नहीं ककया जाता है , इसललए कोई लार्त नहीं बढ़ती है। यदि िेरी पररयोजना प्रार्धकरण के

क् या सड़क पररवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंर्े कक:  
(क) क्या सरकार का भारी यातायात को िेखते ह ुए छपरा-मुजफ्फरपु

र राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग को चार लेन में और छपरा बाईपास को छह लेन में पररवनतगत

      श्रीमती छाया िमाच:  
      र्ौधरी सुखराम लसंह यादि : 
     
क्या ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री यह बताने की कृऩा करेंगे कक्  
 
(क ) क्या यह सर् है कक  ‘मनरेगा’ क े  मद क े  अंतगचत राज्यों को कम धनरालि उऩऱब्ध 
कराई जा रही है जजसक े  कारण मनरेगा मजद ूरों को काम क े  अिसर कम लमऱ रहे हैं ; 
(ख) विगत ऩांर् िर्षों क े  दौरान मनरेगा क े  तहत जारी की गई धनरालि का राज्य-िार ब्यौरा 
क्या है; और  
(ग) क्या सरकार बढ़ती बेरोजगारी को देखते ह ुए मनरेगा क े  कायचकदिसों को बढ़ाने ऩर विर्ार 
कर रही है ताकक मजद ूरों को अऩने गांिों /स्थानीय इऱाकों में कायच लमऱ सक े ?  
उत्तर 
ग्रामीण विकास राज्य मंत्री 
(साध्िी लनरंजन ज्योलत) 
(क ): महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना) 
मांग आधाररत मजद ूरी रोजगार कायचक्रम है जो प्रत्येक ऩररिार जजसक े  ियस्क सदस्य 
अकुिऱ िारीररक श्रम करने क े  इच्छु क हैं , उन्हें प्रत्येक वित्तीय िर्षच में कम से कम 100 कदन 
का गारंटीकृत मजद ूरी रोजगार प्रदान करक े  देि क े  ग्रामीण ऺेत्रों में ऩररिारों की आजीविका 
सुरऺा में िृवि करता है।  ितचमान वित्तीय िर्षच 2021-22 में (26.03.2022 की जस्थलत क े  
अनुसार) महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना क े  अंतगचत  रोजगार की मांग करने िाऱो में से 
99.53% को  रोजगार का प्रस्ताि कदया गया है।

महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना क े  अंतगचत राज्य लनलधयों की ररऱीज क े  प्रस्ताि भारत 
सरकार को प्रस्तुत करते हैं। राज्यों को लनलधयों की ररऱीज लनरंतर र्ऱती रहने िाऱी प्रकक्रया 
है और क ें द्र सरकार इस योजना क े  कायाचन्ियन क े  लऱए राज्यों को लनलधयां उऩऱब्ध कराने क े  
लऱए प्रलतबि है। यह मंत्राऱय “स्िीकृत” श्रम बजट, कायों की मांग , प्रारंलभक िेर्ष, लनलधयों 
क े  उऩयोग की गलत, ऱंवबत देनदाररयों , समग्र लनष्ऩादन को ध्यान में रखते हुए और राज्य 
द्वारा संगत दस्तािेजों की प्रस्तुलत क े  अधीन दो खेऩों में लनलधयां आिलधक रूऩ से ररऱीज 
करता है , जजनमें से प्रत्येक खेऩ में एक या इससे अलधक ककस्तें िालमऱ होती हैं।   
(ख): विगत ऩांर् वित्तीय िर्षों 2016-17, 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20, 2020-21 क े  दौरान 
महात्मा गांधी नरेगा योजना  के  तहत जारी की गई लनलधयों का राज्य /संघ राज्य ऺेत्र-िार 
ब्यौरा अनुबंध में कदया गया है।     
(ग): महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अलधलनयम (महात्मा गांधी नरेगा) का 
उद्देश्य देि क े  ग्रामीण ऺेत्रों में अकुिऱ श्रम कायच करने क े  लऱए इच्छु क ियस्क सदस्यों िाऱे 
प्रत्येक ऩररिार को एक वित्तीय िर्षच में कम से कम 100 कदनों क े गारंटीगृत मजद ूरी रोजगार  
प्रदान करना है। इसक े  अऱािा, सूखा/प्राकृलतक आऩदा प्रभावित ऺेत्रों क े  रूऩ में अलधसूलर्त 
ग्रामीण ऺेत्रों में एक वित्तीय िर्षच में 50 कदनों तक क े  अलतररक्त अकुिऱ मजद ूरी रोजगार का 
प्रािधान है। महात्मा गांधी नरेगा अलधलनयम की धारा  3(4) क े  अनुसार, राज्य सरकारें 
अलधलनयम क े  अंतगचत गारंटी की अिलध से अलतररक्त श्रम कदिसों का रोजगार प्रदान करने का 
प्रािधान अऩनी स्ियं की लनलध से कर सकती हैं।

3148. श्री सतीश र्ंद्र दुबे:    
क्या ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री यह बताने की कृऩा करेंगे कक्  
(क ) क्या सरकार िृिािस्था ऩेंशन, कदवयांग ऩेंशन और लनरालश्रत मकहऱा ऩेंशन क े  ऱाभालथचयों 
को दी जाने िाऱी रालश में कोई िृवि करने का विर्ार रखती है ;  
(ख) रजजस्टर्च ऩेंशनभोलगयों का वबहार सकहत राज्य -िार ब्यौरा क्या है; और  
(ग) क्या सभी राज्यों में ऩेंशन की रालश समान है ? 
  
उत्तर 
ग्रामीण विकास राज्य मंत्री 
(साध्िी लनरंजन ज्योलत) 
(क ): राष्ट्रीय सामाजजक सहायता कायचक्रम (एनएसएऩी) क े  अंतगचत गरीबी रेखा से नीर्े 
(बीऩीएऱ) जीिन याऩन करने िाऱे ऩररिारों क े  40 से 79 िर्च की आयु िगच की विधिाओं और 
18-79 िर्च की आयु िगच क े  कदवयांगजनों को 300/- रुऩये प्रलत माह की दर से और 60 से 79 
िर्च की आयु िगच क े  िृिजनों को 200/- रुऩये प्रलतमाह की दर से मालसक क े न्द्रीय सहायता का 
भुगतान ककया जा रहा है। 80 िर्च या उससे अलधक की आयु क े  इन ऱाभालथचयों को क े न्द्रीय 
सहायता की रालश को बढाकर 500/- रुऩये प्रलत माह कर कदया गया है। एनएसएऩी क े  अंतगचत 
क े न्द्रीय सहायता बढाने का कोई प्रस्ताि नहीं है।  
(ख): वबहार राज्य सकहत एनएसएऩी स्कीमों क े  अंतगचत ऱाभालथचयों का राज्य -िार ब्यौरा अनुबंध 
में कदया गया है।

एक सुव्मिस्थथत थितंत्र गुणित्ता लनगयानी है स्जसका उद्देश्म प्रत्मेक लनभाचण कामच क े  प्रायंलबक र्यण, 
भध्मिती र्यण औय लनभाचण क े  अंलतभ र्यण भें उसका लनय ऺण सुलनस्ित कयना है। तीसये थतय क े  
अंतगचत, जो याष्ट्रीम थतय ऩय है, गुणित्ता की लनगयानी कयने क े  उद्देश्म से सड़क कामों क े  यैंडभ आधाय ऩय 
लनय ऺण क े  लरए औय ऺेत्रीम कामचकताचओं को िरयष्ठ व्मािसालममों का भागचदशचन उऩरब्ध कयाने क े  लरए 
थितंत्र याष्ट्रीम गुणित्ता लनगयानीकताच (एनक्मूएभ) तैनात ककए जाते हैं।  
वऩछरे दो िर्ों औय ितचभान िर्च भें (कदनांक 24.03.2022 तक ) याष्ट्रीम गुणित्ता लनगयानकताचओं 
(एनक्मूएभ) ने छत्तीसगढ़ याज्म भें 892 लनय ऺण ककए हैं। याष्ट्रीम गुणित्ता लनगयानकताचओं (एनक्मूएभ) 
ने इनभें से 2.26% लनभाचणाधीन कामों औय 5.21% यखयखाि कामों की ग्रेकडंग असंतोर्जनक कामों क े  
रूऩ भें की गमी है।  
जफ कबी एनक्मूएभ संयर्नागत औय गैय -संयर्नागत दोर्ों क े  कायण ककसी कामच भें कभी यहने की रयऩोिच 
कयते हैं तफ उस रयऩोिच को उन कलभमों को दशाचते ह ुए , इस अनुदेश क े  साथ याज्म  सयकाय को बेजा 
जाता है कक िे मह सुलनस्ित कयें कक ठेक े दाय भाभरा अनुसाय साभाग्री फदरे मा काय गय  संफंधी कभी को 
ठीक कये। ऐसे प्रत्मेक कामच क े  संफंध भें की गई कायचिाई रयऩोिच (एि आय) का ज़भीनी थतय ऩय सत्माऩन 
याज्म गुणित्ता लनगयानीकताच (एसक्मूएभ) कयते हैं। तत्ऩिात , याज्म गुणित्ता सभन्िमकताच (एसक्मूसी) 
ऐसे प्रत्मेक कामच की एि आय की जांर् कयक े  अनुऩारन रयऩोिच लनमलभत रूऩ से इस कामचक्रभ की M I S-
O M M A S क े  भाध्मभ से प्रथतुत कयते हैं। कपय इस एि आय की जांर् एनआयआईड ए द्वाया की जाती है औय 
मकद मह ऩामा जाए कक अनुऩारन नह ं ह ुआ तो उऩमुक्त कायचिाई की जाती है।

3184 श्ऱी नारायण दास गुप्ता: 
  
 क्या महहला एवं बाल हवकास  मंत्ऱी यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :  
 
(क ) क्या कदल्ल़ी सरकार  ने मार्च , 2022 से आंगनवाड़ी कायचकताचओं  को प्रहतमाह मानदेय हनधाचररत ककया  
है जो देश में सबसे अहधक  है;  
(ख) क्या आंगनवाड़ी कायचकताचओं  को बेहतर  तऱीक े से कायच  करने  में मदद करने  के  हलए हवहभन्न राज्यों में 
आंगनवाड़ी कायचकताचओं  को मानदेय के  संबंध में एक  समान ऩीहत तैयार की  जा सकत़ी है;

करेगा ; और  
(घ) क्या राज्यों के  परामशच से देश में आंगनवाड़ी कायचकताचओं  की सामाहजक  सुरक्षा बढाने के  हलए ककस़ी 
प्रकार की रूपरेखा तैयार करना  संभव है?

3185 श्री देरेक  ओब्राईन:   
 क्या महहला एवं बाल हवकास मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :  
 
(क ) क्या सरकार  द्वारा देश में लावाररस बच्चों की  संख्या के  संबंध में हाल ही में कोई  अध्ययन ककया  
गया है, यकद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और यकद नहीं, तो इसक े क्या कारण  हैं; और  
(ख) लावाररस बच्चों, हवशेषकर लड़ककयों को बर्ाने, उनका  पुनवाचस और सशहिकरण करने  के  हलए क्या 
योजनाएं हैं और इनमें से प्रत्येक के  हलए बजटीय आबंटन ककतना  है?  
  
 
उत्‍तर 
श्रीमती स्‍मृहत जूहबन इरानी     महहला एवं बाल हवकास मंत्री 
 
(क ) और ( ख) : जैसा कक  राष्ट्रीय बालक  अहधकार संरक्षण आयोग (एनसीपीसीआर) द्वारा सूहर्त ककया  
गया है, सड़कों पर रहने वाले बच्चों की ररयल टाइम हनगरानी के  हलए एक  ऑनलाइन पोटचल बाल स्वराज 
– बाल स्वराज पोटचल – सीआईएसएस तैयार ककया  गया है। सड़कों पर रहने वाले बच्चों के  संदभच में 
2021 के  एसएमडब््यूपी (सी) संख्या 6 में माननीय उच्चतम न्यायालय द्वारा सभी राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों 
को ऐसे बच्चों का डेटा अपलोड करने  का हनदेश कदया गया है हजन्हें सड़क पर रहने वाले बच्चों के  रूप  में 
हर्हन्हत ककया  गया है।  
 
 मंत्रालय बाल संरक्षण सेवा (सीपीएस) स्कीम – हमशन वात्स्य नामक  एक  क ें द्र प्रायोहजत स्कीम 
र्ला रहा है हजसक े तहत सड़कों पर रहने वाले बच्चों का बर्ाव और पुनवाचस सहहत देखरेख के  जरूरतमंद  
और करिन पररहस्थहतयों के  हशकार बच्चों के  हलए सेवाएं प्रदान करने  के  हलए राज्य सरकारों  और संघ 
राज्य क्षेत्र प्रशासनों को  सहायता प्रदान की  जाती है। स्कीम के  तहत स्थाहपत बाल देखरेख संस्थाएं 
(सीसीआई) अन्य बातों के  साथ आयु के  अनुरूप  हशक्षा, व्यावसाहयक प्रहशक्षण तक  पहंर्, मनोरंजन, 
स्वास््य देखरेख आकद के  हलए मदद प्रदान करती  हैं। हवत्त वषच 2021-22 के  हलए सीपीएस-हमशन 
वात्स्य के  हलए बजट आवंटन 900.00 करोड़ रुपये है।

(ग) यकद हां, तो इसक े क्या कारण  हैं?    
 
उत्‍तर 
श्रीमती स्‍मृहत जूहबन इरानी     महहला एवं बाल हवकास मंत्री

आंगनवाड़ी सेवाओं, ककशोररयों  के  हलए स्कीम और प्रधानमंत्री मातृ वंदना योजना ( पीएमएमवीवाई ) का

 इस मंत्रालय ने 1000 हवधवाओं के  हलए वृंदावन, मथुरा, उत्तर प्रदेश में ' क ृ ष्णा क ु टीर'

इसका  उद्देश्य हवधवाओं को  ठहरने  का एक  सुरहक्षत और सुहनहित स्थान, स्वास््य सेवाएं, पौहिक
